attribution.note: Zitron directly asserts the capability claim in his own voice.

semantics.note: The proposition faithfully isolates capability delivery from the separate assertion about enthusiasts' motives.

contract.note: Reliable useful work with less supervision is an ordinary contextual reading. The evaluator supplies the May window and operational measures; neither was specified by Zitron.

evidence.note: The dated company disclosure helps establish qualified promises about autonomy. Its April productivity assertions do not establish May performance.
Available before the cutoff and describing May, this company disclosure reports substantial task success. It lacks matched promises, representative tasks and measured net human effort.

reviews.rationale: Neither item supplies a representative comparison between promised autonomy and May performance under matching conditions. Reported successes and remaining failures cannot establish whether the promises were generally delivered.

attribution.note: The passage is Zitron's own endorsed assessment and forecast.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the current criticisms and firm prediction of eventual financing insufficiency. It supplies no finite deadline.

contract.note: Reading the endpoint as inability to sustain the prevailing strategy is fair. Industry membership and durable self-financing are evaluator operationalizations; individual failures or fundraising cannot resolve it.

evidence.note: The filing discloses financing dependence and risks at Anthropic. It establishes neither industry-wide capital exhaustion nor inevitable failure.
The company announced a proposed IPO before the cutoff. Registration establishes neither completed financing nor durable industry-wide sustainability.

reviews.rationale: The forecast has no deadline, and neither early-resolution event is documented. Financing risks at one firm and an unfinished IPO process do not settle the industry's eventual ability to continue.

attribution.note: Zitron presents this as his own qualified conclusion.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves exclusivity and the confidence hedge. The central claim concerns capex effects and necessary financing dependence, making it causal rather than merely observational.

contract.note: The contract acknowledges the confidence hedge but supplies criteria for scoring a firm exclusivity claim. The policy's plain-reading permission does not extend to hedged language.

evidence.note: OpenAI discloses committed financing, not cash received or proof that hyperscaler revenue depended exclusively on that financing.

The filing supports the narrower Anthropic unprofitability component. Financing-instrument valuation losses do not establish equivalent cash burn, OpenAI's losses or industry-wide financing dependence.
Microsoft reports an annualized AI revenue rate. It does not disclose matched realized revenue, customer concentration or returns on comparable AI capex.

reviews.rationale: The central exclusivity conclusion is qualified by a confidence hedge and is therefore unscored under the policy. The financial disclosures do not justify turning it into a firm claim; they also leave the broader financing counterfactual unestablished.

attribution.note: Both the exclusivity assertion and numerical estimate are Zitron's own.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the named GPU models, exclusivity and estimated lower bound. Describing a numerical measurement as an estimate does not itself express a probabilistic outcome.

contract.note: The quarter and provider-by-provider reading are reasonable operational choices. The packet remains insufficient under either separate-provider or combined-provider readings.

evidence.note: Amazon's quarterly disclosure supplies an AWS revenue denominator, but no corresponding purchases by the two labs.
Google names other Dataflow GPU users and announces H100 support. It does not tie their paid usage to the specified GPU models during the target quarter.

reviews.rationale: The packet supplies neither matched customer spending shares nor verified revenue from other customers on the specified GPUs. The Google disclosure is relevant counterevidence but does not establish the facts needed to contradict exclusivity.
